documents.title: Customer incident description (email)
documents.text:
From: meera.p.chn@mailbox.example
To: claims@nimbusgeneral.example
Subject: Claim for TN10BX3391 - accident on 3rd April - delay explanation

Dear claims team,

I wish to claim for damage to my Nexon (TN10BX3391). On 3rd April 2026 evening, I was waiting in traffic at the ECR signal near Thiruvanmiyur when a small delivery van in front reversed suddenly and hit the front... sorry, the REAR of my car (I was behind him and he reversed back onto me). The rear bumper cracked, the boot door got dented and the right side tail light broke. The van driver argued and left, I did not take it to the police as there was no injury.

I had to fly to Singapore on 5th April for an office assignment and was there till 24th April, which is why I could not submit the claim or give the car to the garage earlier. I understand there has been a delay of about three weeks and I request you to please consider the circumstances.

The car was inspected by Marina Car Care on 25th and their estimate of Rs 54,300 is attached with the claim form.

Regards,
Meera Pillai
